title: Mohamed ke Shehr
body:
ghar kis ka jal raha hai mohamed ke shehr may
yeh kaun ro raha hai mohamed ke shehr may
<<DIVIDER>>
kaisa ye waqt aaya koi jaanta nahi
beti nabi ki hai koi pehchaanta nahi
mazloom fatema hai mohamed ke shehr may
ghar kis ka jal raha hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
pyare nabi ne jism ka tukda kaha jise
tazeem jiski karte thay uski hi pusht pe
darwaza gir raha hai mohamed ke shehr may
ghar kis ka jal raha hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
zehra ko ek dard ka marham na mil saka
kehta hai par har ek musalman barmala
har dard ki dawa hai mohamed ke shehr may
ghar kis ka jal raha hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
baad e rasool qadr na jaani batool ki
darbar may khadi hai nishani rasool ki
mehroom fatema hai mohamed ke shehr may
ghar kis ka jal raha hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
baba ke paas beti ki turbat na ban sake
hai koi chashme beena jo insaaf se kahe
ye kya sitam hua hai mohamed ke shehr may
ghar kis ka jal raha hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
kisne gale may daali hai hyder ke rassiyan
tooti hai kaise fatema zehra ki phasliyan
kya haadsa hua hai mohamed ke shehr may
ghar kis ka jal raha hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
afsos kalma goyon ne is ko nahi suna
rehta tha jo batool ke honton pe marsiya
wo ab bhi goonjta hai mohamed ke shehr may
ghar kis ka jal raha hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
allah re baqiyye ki ghurbat wo bekasi
sadiyan guzar gayi hai magar aaj bhi koi
ghut ghut ke ro raha hai mohamed ke shehr may
ghar kis ka jal raha hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
aamir ye kalma goyon ne socha nahi kabhi
ainee janabe fatema jaan e rasool ki
marqad pe bhi jafa hai mohamed ke shehr may
ghar kiska jal raha hai...
author: Ainee Rizvi
